notes.title: Stargate: Timekeepers - Face 2 Face with Eva McCain
notes.content:
Discover the story behind the characters of [b]Stargate: Timekeepers[/b] with the new series [b]"Face 2 Face"[/b]. Here the first episode about Eva McCain, the Team Commander.  

[b]Name:[/b]
Eva McCain 

[b]Role:[/b]
Team Commander 

[b]Personality:[/b] 
Perfectionist, strong moral code, leader. 

[b]Background:[/b] 
Graduated the officer school with excellent scores. After years of service, she was promoted to lead one of the SG teams. She had a short romance with Max Bolton.
She finds it very difficult to believe in the timeloop. She would be willing to sacrifice anything to save as many lives as possible. Her redemption story is only possible due to the timeloop, where Max Bolton finally develops enough leadership skills to convince her that the timeloop is real and he can handle it with her help.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41645534/bd4821a1432298b75836fd6990688d3062650a67.jpg[/img]
You can download Eva's artwork [url=https://ftp.matrixgames.com/pub/Stargate-Timekeepers/stargate.zip][u][b]here[/b][/u][/url].

[b]Skills & Accessories:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Tactical binoculars: Showcases weak points on an enemy, removing stun immunities 
[*] Rifle stock hit: Physical stun on single enemy in melee range
[*] Rifle burst: Deals damage to multiple enemies within character’s view cone
[*] Kull disruptor (automatic rifle): Deals damage to single target / bypasses Kull warriors immunities
[/list]

[previewyoutube=m-g7ks0yXg8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Stargate: Timekeepers - Patch Notes - 1.00.34
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First of all we would like to thank all the fans who have been supporting Stargate: Timekeepers Season 1 Part 1 since its launch. 

The team has been working relentlessy to deliver you the best possible gaming experience and please let us know what you think of the list of changes. Your feedback is essential to keep improving the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41645534/134c2653f89d88a54c117b530b0f7d116fe704bf.png[/img]
[i](Pre-production concept image)[/i]

Here below the detailed changelog is available for you:
[h3]QoL features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have added a feature that, when enabled in the settings, causes the character to approach the nearest possible location if the target of the skill is out of range at the time of selection, in order to place themselves within range.
[*] By holding down the LMB button for an extended period, you can now place an Enemy Vision marker to check which of the opponents is observing the designated location in real-time.
[/list]
[h3]Voice overs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have added new voiceover lines for enemies.
[/list]
[h3]General fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player characters and enemies should utilize ladders in a more organized manner now.
[*] Fixes to player character animations.
[*] Reducing the duration of alarms.
[*] Fixes for enemy drone VFX.
[*] Disabling Unity Analytics.
[*] Fixed achievements bug on GOG
[/list]

notes.title: Stargate: Timekeepers - Patch Notes - 1.00.25
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

First of all we would like to thank all the fans who have supported the launch of Stargate: Timekeepers Season 1 Part 1. 

The team has been working relentlessy to deliver you the best possible gaming experience and please let us know what you think of the list of changes. Your feedback is essential to keep improving the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41645534/134c2653f89d88a54c117b530b0f7d116fe704bf.png[/img]
[i](Pre-production concept image)[/i]

The new update includes improvements and fixes across all areas of the game. Here below the detailed changelog is available for you:

[h3]General fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tactical Mode should now execute properly on Alternative Controls
[*] Achievement involving opportunities should be unlockable now (If you are sure that you discovered all opportunities, click on opportunity in Mission 1 again)
[*] In specific cases resolution will be set to native one to prevent bug with vertical resolution from happening
[/list]
[h3]Characters and enemies behavior[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sam should not be detectable anymore when opening ammo boxes in disguise
[*] Fixed issue when disguise was not loading again after saving in Drop Disguise sphere  
[*] Enemies will not lock themselves in body examining state; they will not behave weird when body is in unreachable place
[*] Fixed situation in which enemy distracted by player was not continuing his patrol 
[/list]
[h3]Fixes in missions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in which Mission 3 sometimes could not load properly after disguising Sam as Svirda
[*] Disabled clicking on wheel in Mission 3 when Max isn't on second vantage point that mission
[*] Minimap on Mission 7 will now display properly after load 
[*] Mission 6 teleporter opportunity is now behaving properly; clipping through rings was removed
[/list]
[h3]Technical fixes[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Optimisation of save game icons 
[*] Fixes in ragdoll
[*] Polishing animations
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1523650/Stargate_Timekeepers/

notes.title: Stargate: Timekeepers - Special live event recap
notes.content:
A free [b]Episode One[/b] of Season One of [b]Stargate: Timekeepers[/b] deployed on Steam. 

[b]Stargate: Timekeepers will be released on December 12th[/b]. You can pre-order the game on Steam. 

[previewyoutube=Ij9D-0uBVsc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Stargate: Timekeepers[/b] propels players into the heart of the Stargate SG-1 universe, where they will lead a team of specialists through a riveting campaign filled with story and adventure. [b]Episode One[/b] plunges players into the heart-pounding chaos of the Battle of Antarctica, with valiant Eva McCain being teamed up to navigate treacherous challenges in an attempt to stop the deadly Kull warriors.

[h3]A Real-Time Tactical Odyssey[/h3]

In a celebration of the Episode One release, Slitherine invited Martin Wood, director and producer of Stargate SG-1, Michael Shanks, actor of Stargate SG-1, Darren Sumner, owner and managing editor of GateWorlds.net and Robert Brown, writer of Stargate: Timekeepers, for a Twitch live show yesterday. Fans and newcomers alike could delve deep into the wondrous world of Stargate.

If you've missed the live stream, you can rewatch it here: 

[previewyoutube=K7EFMojaiJQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Stargate: Timekeepers[/b], while rooted in the iconic universe, boldly charts a new course beyond the conclusion of the seventh season of Stargate SG-1. Fans can expect an entirely fresh and captivating story arc, filled with the thrilling adventures and enigmatic discoveries that have come to define the Stargate legacy. Stargate: Timekeepers features an original and richly detailed story-driven campaign spanning 14 episodes, in which players need to use a combination of stealth, skills, and combat prowess to achieve success.

Characters take center stage in [b]Stargate: Timekeepers[/b], each featuring a unique skill set to be used to overcome obstacles, foes, and in-game puzzles. Each episode in the real-time tactics game needs careful planning and expert use of skills, with the player likely requiring more stealth than guns blazing.

[b]Stargate: Timekeepers[/b] will be divided into two parts, season one part one and season one part two, with each segment containing seven episodes. Each individual episode is a full single-player mission. Players who purchase Stargate: Timekeepers will get full access to all the episodes in this first season as they become available.
